title: Savory Simmered Beef Meatballs
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely grated yellow onion, including released juices
2 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped (or 2 tsp dried)
1 to 2 tbsp olive oil or avocado oil, for searing
instructions: Mix the meatball mixture: In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, grated onion with its juices, eggs, panko, granulated garlic, parsley, salt, pepper, and oregano. Gently fold and mix with your hands just until incorporated; avoid overmixing, which can make lean beef tough.
Shape the meatballs: Lightly dampen your hands with water to prevent sticking. Roll into uniform 1.5-inch meatballs, about 1.5 to 2 tablespoons each. This batch yields roughly 32 to 36 meatballs.

Sear the exterior: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium heat. Working in batches to avoid overcrowding, brown the meatballs on all sides for about 3 to 4 minutes. They do not need to be cooked through.

Simmer in sauce: Pour the homemade sauce over the seared meatballs, or gently nestle them into a wide pot of simmering sauce. Bring the sauce to a gentle bubble, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir occasionally until the meatballs are cooked through and tender.
Rest: Remove from heat and let the meatballs rest in the sauce for 5 minutes before serving.
